name: interaction matrices
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学

complete_examples.text: Unlike explicit force-based methods, the vehicle-track systems are wholly coupled by interaction matrices and load vectors, which are computationally more efficient than most of the existing methods and fairly accurate in low frequency vibrations.
The interaction matrices between the track and substructure are therefore demanded.
In a robust and cost-effective manner, substructures are modeled as independent matrices including their interaction matrices to the upper track.
